question.html:
Question 4
?

The ratio of vanilla flavored cakes to total cakes in a bakery is 5:9. What is the meaning of this ratio?

a
The bakery has exactly 5 vanilla flavored cakes
b
The bakery has exactly 9 cakes
c
Out of every 9 cakes in the bakery, 5 of them are vanilla flavored cakes
d
The bakery has exactly 14 cakes
e
Out of every 5 cakes in the bakery, 9 of them are vanilla flavored cakes
Don't Know
